custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১) A clever student solved the problem. (make it complex)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: A student is clever who solved the problem.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: A student who is clever always solves the problem.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: A student who is clever solved the problem.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: A clever student always solved the problem.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Adjective + noun যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে প্রদত্ত article বসে।
- Adjective এর পরের noun টি বসে।
- Relative pronoun who/which/that বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী verb বসে +
- Adjective টি বসে +
- প্রদত্ত noun এর পর থেকে শেষ অংশ বসে। 

• Simple sentence: A clever student solved the problem.
• Complex sentence: A student who is clever solved the problem.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২) The teacher is going to announce the result. (Make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: The result is going to be announced by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: The result was going to be announced by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: The result is being announced by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: The result is going to announce by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• be going to দিয়ে Active Voice থাকলে তা Passive Voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর Object টি Passive voice এর Subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- going to এর কোন পরিবর্তন হয় না।
- going to এরপর be বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ Object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active Voice: The teacher is going to announce the result.
• Passive Voice: The result is going to be announced by the teacher.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৩) By working hard, you can succeed in life. (Make it complex)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: If you will work hard, you can succeed in life.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: By working hard, success can be achieved.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: If you work hard, you can succeed in life.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: If you have worked hard, you can succeed in life.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• By/ In case of/ In the event of + gerund যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence করার নিয়ম:
- By/ In case of/ In the event of এর পরবর্তী gerund (যেমন: studying, reading, working, etc.) বাদ যাবে এবং If দিয়ে Complex Sentence এর শুরু করতে হবে।
- ২য় clause এর subject বসবে।
- Verb + ১ম Clause এর বাকী অংশ বসে।
- ২য় Clause- টি অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে।

• Simple Sentence: By working hard, you can succeed in life.
• Complex Sentence: If you work hard, you can succeed in life.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৪) Tania is more talented than any other student in the class. (make it positive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: No other students in the class are as talented as Tania.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: No other student in the class is as talented as Tania.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Very few student in the class is as talented as Tania.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: No other student in the class is talented as Tania.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Than any other/ all other যুক্ত Comparative degree কে Positive degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Positive degree এ sentence এর শুরুতে No other বসে।
- Than any other বা all other এর পরের অংশ বসে। 
- Verb বসে।
- as + Comparative degree এর positive form বসে + as বসে।
- Comparative degree এর subject বসে।
  
• Structure: No other + any other / all other এর পরের অংশ + verb + as +Comparative degree এর positive form + as + প্রদত্ত sentence এর subject.

• Comparative degree: Tania is more talented than any other student in the class.
• Positive degree: No other student in the class is as talented as Tania.

• Note:
- মাঝে মধ্যে As এর পরিবর্তে So negative অর্থে এ ব্যবহার করা হয়।)

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৫) Chittagong is one of the busiest ports in Bangladesh. (make it comparative)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Chittagong is busier than the most other ports in Bangladesh.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Chittagong is busier most other ports in Bangladesh.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Most other ports in Bangladesh are busier than Chittagong.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Chittagong is busier than most other ports in Bangladesh.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর sub এবং verb বসে।
- One of the উঠে যায়।
- Superlative Degree এর Comparative form বসে।
- than most other বসে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে। 

• Superlative Degree: Chittagong is one of the busiest ports in Bangladesh.
• Comparative Degree: Chittagong is busier than most other ports in Bangladesh.

Source: A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৬) No other student is as hardworking as Rahim. (Make it superlative)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Very few students are as hardworking as Rahim.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Rahim is the most hardworking student.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Rahim is the hardworking student.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Rahim is one of the most hardworking student.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• No other যুক্ত Positive degree কে Superlative degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- Superlative degree তে প্রথমে no other বাদ যাবে।
- Object (Positive degree -এর পরের) টি Subject হয়ে বসবে।
- Subject অনুসারে verb বসবে।
- the + superlative degree বসবে।
- no other এর পরের Subject টি Object হয়ে বসবে।
- বাকি অংশ বসবে।

• Positive degree: No other student is as hardworking as Rahim.
• Superlative degree: Rahim is the most hardworking student.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৭) The Gobi is one of the coldest deserts in the world. (make it positive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Very few desert in the world is as cold as the Gobi.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: No other desert in the world is as cold as the Gobi.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: No other deserts in the world are as cold as the Gobi.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Very few deserts in the world are as cold as the Gobi.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Positive Degree করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Very few বসে।
- Superlative Adjective এর পর থেকে বাকি অংশ বসে।
- Verb এর Plural form বসে।
- As + Superlative এর positive form + As বসে।
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর Subject বসে।

• Superlative Degree: The Gobi is one of the coldest deserts in the world.
• Positive Degree: Very few deserts in the world are as cold as the Gobi.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৮) If you do not eat on time, you may become ill. (Make it simple)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: When you eat on time, you may become ill.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Without eating on time, you may become ill.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Eating on time, you may become ill.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Because of eating on time, you may become ill.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• If দ্বারা গঠিত শর্তমূলক না বোধক complex sentence কে simple করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে without বসে+ ‘if’ clause এর মূল verb এর present form এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + verb -এর পরের অংশ বসে।
- তারপর দ্বিতীয় clause টি বসে।

• Complex sentence: If you do not eat on time, you may become ill.
• Simple sentence: Without eating on time, you may become ill.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৯) She is one of the tallest girls in our school. (Make it comparative)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: She is taller than many other girl in our school.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: She is taller than most other girls in our school.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: She is more taller than most other girls in our school.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: She is taller than any other girls in our school.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে প্রদত্ত Sentence এর Subject ও Verb বসে,
- One of the উঠে যায়,
- Superlative Degree-এর Comparative form বসে,
- than most other বসে,
- প্রদত্ত Sentence- এর বাকী অংশ বসে।

• Structure: Subject + Verb + Superlative Degree এর Comparative form + than most other + প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ।

• Superlative degree: She is one of the tallest girls in our school.
• Comparative degree: She is taller than most other girls in our school.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১০) Though he worked hard, he failed in the exam. (Make it simple)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: In spite of his working hard, he failed in the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Because it his working hard, he failed in the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Despite of his working hard, he failed in the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: In spite of he worked hard, he failed in the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Though/ Although যুক্ত  Clause- টিতে মূল verb থাকে তখন Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Though/ Although এর পরিবর্তে Despite/ In Spite of বসে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর possessive form বসে।
- মূল verb এর present form এর সাথে ing বসে।
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসবে।

• Complex sentence: Though he worked hard, he failed in the exam.
• Simple sentence: In spite of his working hard, he failed in the exam.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১১) The teacher made the students write the report. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: The students were made to written the report by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: The students were made writing the report by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: The students were made written the report by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: The students were made to write the report by the teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, heed, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice কে Passive Voice রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর Object টি Passive voice এর Subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past participle form বসে।
- Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, heed, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice এ to উহ্য থাকে।
- কিন্তু Passive করার সময় তাদের পর to বসে এবং ২য় verb টির Present form বসে।
- তবে, Let Verb টির পরে Active ও Passive Voice এ To বসে না। 
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে। 

• Active Voice: The teacher made the students write the report.
• Passive Voice: The students were made to write the report by the teacher.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১২) Study hard or you will fail the exam. (Make it simple)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Without studying hard, you will fail the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Studying hard, you will fail the exam.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: You will fail the exam and study hard.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: You will fail the exam if you study hard.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Or যুক্ত Compound sentence কে Simple sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Without বসে।
- প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হবে।
- Verb এর পরের অংশ বসে।
- or এর পরিবর্তে Comma (,) বসে।
- ২য় senetnce টি বসে।

• Compound Sentence: Study hard or you will fail the exam.
• Simple Sentence: Without studying hard, you will fail the exam.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৩) Very few players in the team are as skilled as Karim. (make it superlative)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Karim is one of the most skilled players in the team.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Karim is the most skilled players in the team.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Karim is most of the skilled players in the team.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Karim is one than the most skilled players in the team.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Very few যুক্ত Positive Degree কে Superlative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত Sentence টির শেষের Subject প্রথমে বসে।
- verb বসে।
- one of the বসে।
- Positive Degree এর Superlative form বসে।
- Very few এরপর থেকে verb এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত অংশ বসে।

• Structure: প্রদত্ত Sentence টির শেষের Subject প্রথমে বসে + verb + one of the + Positive Degree এর Superlative form + Very few এরপর থেকে verb এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত অংশ বসে।

• Positive Degree: Very few players in the team are as skilled as Karim.
• Superlative Degree: Karim is one of the most skilled players in the team.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৪) If you do not hurry, you will miss the train. (make it compound)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Hurry and you will miss the train.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Hurry but you will miss the train.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Hurry or you will miss the train.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Without hurrying you will miss the train.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• If যুক্ত Complex sentence টি যদি Negative অর্থবোধক হয়, তবে Compound Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- If থেকে not পর্যন্ত উঠে যাবে।
- not এরপর থেকে কমার আগ পর্যন্ত বাকি অংশটি বসে।
- or বসে।
- বাকি Clause টি বসে।

• Complex Sentence: If you do not hurry, you will miss the train.
• Compound Sentence: Hurry or you will miss the train.

• Note:
- তবে sentence টি যদি Affirmative Sentence হয় তাহলে or এর পরিবর্তে and বসে।
- বাকি সব উপরের rule এর মতোই ঠিক থাকবে।

• Complex Sentence: If you run fast, you can win the prize.
• Compound Sentence: Run fast and you can win the prize.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৫) One should take care of one's health. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: One's health have been taken care of by one.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Health should be taken care of.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Someone should be taken care of.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: You are requested to taken care of.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• One + should যুক্ত sentence কে passive করার নিয়ম:
- One's বাদ দিয়ে one's এর সাথের Object টি subject হিসেবে Passive voice- এ বসে।
- Should এর জন্য Should be বসে।
- verb এর past participle বসে।

• Active voice: One should take care of one's health.
• Passive voice: Health should be taken care of.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৬) My teacher embodies all the good qualities. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: All the good qualities are embodied by my teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: All the good qualities are embodied with my teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: All the good qualities are embodied to my teacher.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
[27 BCS Preli]

• Present Indefinite Tense এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject এ হয়।
- am/ is/ are + মূল verb এর past participle ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- মূল verb এর past participle বসে।
- Passive voice এ contain, embody, include, subsume ইত্যাদি verb এর passive form এ in বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে। 

• Active Voice: My teacher embodies all the good qualities.
• Passive Voice: All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৭) When it was evening, I saw the children playing in the field. (make it simple)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: In evening I was seeing the children playing in the field.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: I seen the children playing in the evening in the field.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: By the children playing in the field I saw in the evening.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: At evening I saw the children playing in the field.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• When যুক্ত Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence করার নিয়ম:
- When উঠে যায় এবং when এরপরের অংশে যে Subject ও Verb থাকে টা উঠে যায়। 
- ছোট সময় বুঝালে at/ in বসে।
- ঋতু বুঝালে তার পূর্বে in বসে।
- বয়স বুঝালে at the age of বসে।
- Comma (,) এরপরের অংশ বসবে।

• Complex Sentence: When it was evening, I saw the children playing in the field.
• Simple Sentence: At evening I saw the children playing in the field.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৮) He is too young to join the army. (make it complex)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: He is so young that he can not join the army.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: He is young that he can not join the army.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: He is so young that he could not join the army.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: He is too young that he can not join the army.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Too + --- + to যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Complex sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Subject এরপরে প্রথম too এর জায়গায় so বসে।
- Too + --- + to এর মাঝের Adjective word টি বসে।
- to এর পরিবর্তে that বসে।
- প্রথম subject টির Pronoun form বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী can not/ could not বসে।
- বাকী অংশ বসে।

• Simple sentence: He is too young to join the army. 
• Complex sentence: He is so young that he can not join the army.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৯) He met his friend at the time of studying. (Make it complex)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: He met his friend when he is studying.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: He met his friend when he was studying.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: He met his friend and he was studying.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: He met his friend when he was studied.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Simple sentence এ যদি at the time of থাকে তাহলে simple sentence কে complex করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথম clause টি অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে।
- at the time of এর পরিবর্তে when বসে।
- প্রথম clause টির tense এর form অনুযায়ী পরবর্তী clause টি he was studying হয়েছে। 

• Simple Sentence: He met his friend at the time of studying. 
• Complex Sentence: He met his friend when he was studying.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২০) The manager determined to implement the new policy. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: The manager determined that the new policy should being implemented.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: The manager determined that the new policy should been implemented.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: The manager determined that the new policy is implemented.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: The manager determined that the new policy should be implemented.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Agree/ be anxious/ arrange/ determine/ be determined/ decide/ demand + infinitive object যুক্ত sentence কে Active Voice কে Passive Voice করার নিয়ম: 
- প্রদত্ত Active Voice এর Subject ও Verb বসবে।
- that বসে।
- Infinitive এর পরের Object বসবে।
- should be বসে।
- Infinitive এর পরের verb এর Past Participle বসে।

• Active Voice: The manager determined to implement the new policy.
• Passive Voice: The manager determined that the new policy should be implemented.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২১) The boys were playing football. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Football were being played by the boys.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Football were being played to the boys.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Football was being played by the boys.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Football was being played for the boys.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Past continuous tense এর ক্ষেত্রে Active voice থেকে Passive Voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Subject অনুযায়ী was being/ were being বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Structure: Object এর subject + Subject অনুযায়ী was being/ were being + মূল verb এর past participle form + by + Subject এর object.

• Active voice: The boys were playing football.
• Passive voice: Football was being played by the boys.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২২) The tree has been uprooted. (make it active)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: The tree uproots someone.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: The tree has uprooted by someone.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: A storm has been uprooted the tree.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: A storm has uprooted the tree.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• বাক্যে ক্রিয়ার কর্তা উহ্য থাকলে passive থেকে active করার সময় একটি কর্তা যেমন: 
- Active voice এ Subject হিসেবে someone, somebody, people, the authority, people, fire, the storm ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence টির Active voice এ has been এর পরিবর্তে has বসবে।  
- tense অনুসারে verb এর form ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- Passive voice এর subject টি active voice এ object হিসেবে বসবে।

• Passive voice: The tree has been uprooted.
• Active voice: A storm has uprooted the tree.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২৩) Who is interrupting the class? (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: By whom is being the class interrupted?
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: By whom is the class being interrupted?
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Whom is the class being interrupted by?
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Who is the class being interrupted?
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এর রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে By whom দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হবে।
- tense ও person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী be/ being/ been বসাতে হয়।
- মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Question mark (?) হয়।

• Active voice: Who is interrupting the class?
• Passive voice: By whom is the class being interrupted?

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২৪) You ought to follow the instructions. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: The instructions ought to be followed by you.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: The instructions ought be followed by you.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: The instructions are ought to be followed by you.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: The instructions have ought to be followed by you.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• Active voice এ Modal Auxiliary Verb থাকলে তা Passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Modal Auxiliary verb গুলো হলো: Can, Could, May, Might, Will, Would, Shall, Should, Ought to, Used to, Must ইত্যাদি।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Active voice এর Modal verb টি বসে।
- be বসে।
- প্রদত্ত মুল verb এর past participle বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active Voice: You ought to follow the instructions.
• Passive voice: The instructions ought to be followed by you.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২৫) Buy her a book. (make it passive)
ডেইলি কুইজ.option1: Let a book be brought for her.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option2: Let a book be bought by her.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option3: Let a book be bought for her.
ডেইলি কুইজ.option4: Let a book be bought to her.
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
• শুধুমাত্র মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু করা Imparetive sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রুপান্তরের নিয়ম:
 - Let দিয়ে Passive voice এর বাক্যটি শুরু হবে।
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active voice এর Verb এরপর Passive voice এ by ছাড়া অন্য preparation বসে। যেমন: to, at, on, with, for ইত্যাদি।
- bought এর সাথে preparation হিসেবে সব সময় for বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: Buy her a book.
• Passive voice: Let a book be bought for her.

• Note:
ক) Let a book be brought for her.
- ভুল। কারণ, brought হলো bring এর past participle.
- প্রদত্ত প্রশ্নে মূল verb হিসেবে buy রয়েছে। তাই এখানে brought না হয়ে bought হবে।

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
